homeContent: I am Mohith, a full stack developer who likes turning ambitious ideas into fast, dependable products. This room is a small map of how I work: curious, hands-on, and always shipping.
skillsContent: My core stack is React, Next.js, TypeScript, and Node.js. I also work across APIs, product design, AI tooling, and performance engineering, choosing whatever helps the idea become a clear, useful product.
contactContent: Have a product to build, a difficult interface to untangle, or an idea worth testing? Reach out through any channel below. I read every message.
